messages:
harper: Quick heads-up. Finance pulled nightly reconciliation and found ~31 invoices where Stripe shows credit notes but NetSuite never received the apply. Clustered around 2026-05-18 02:00-02:40 UTC. Posting here to coordinate.

leo: Any sign of webhook delivery issues or DLQ?

billing-bot: [auto] webhook-delivery delay-spike detected window=2026-05-18T01:55..2026-05-18T02:45 count=412 avg_delay=154s

nina: I pulled a few raw payloads. Noticed a field `preview_experiment=true` and `experiment_id=exp-pricing-sim-2026` on many of the refund/credit events. Our apply-worker explicitly ignores payloads flagged preview because they were part of the pricing experiment simulation. Looks like the experiment flag leaked into production traffic for a ~45m window.

harper: That explains it. Finance saw the Stripe credit objects (they're real) but our processor filtered them due to preview flag. How did preview flag leak?

leo: The pricing team ran a canary pricing-sim toggle that was scoped to beta customers, but a routing misconfig caused the header X-Billing-Experiment to be forwarded from test cluster to prod webhook proxy. We're investigating the rollout path.

ops-bot: [auto] feature-toggle change detected: pricing-sim.enabled=true scope=canary by @mae at 2026-05-18T01:58:12Z

billing-bot: [auto] suppressed_count=31 reason="preview_event" path=s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/suppressed/2026-05-18/

nina: Immediate plan: 1) toggle pricing-sim.canary off in the proxy to stop more preview flags, 2) extract suppressed preview events and replay with special path that treats preview events as real (since they correspond to real charges), 3) reconcile with finance and create memos for any closed invoices.

harper: Finance wants a dry-run first and an audit trail linking stripe credit -> ns_apply_id. Also need to check for duplicates because some customers retried payments after seeing balance mismatch.

leo: Commands I used to enumerate payloads:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/suppressed/2026-05-18/ | grep preview | wc -l
aws s3 sync s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/suppressed/2026-05-18/ ./suppressed_may18/
python tools/extract_credit_ids.py --dir ./suppressed_may18/ --filter preview=true > preview_ids.txt
```

ops-bot: [auto] feature-toggle toggled pricing-sim.canary=false by @ops at 2026-05-18T03:10:01Z

nina: Dry-run: `python tools/replay_webhooks.py --ids-file preview_ids.txt --dry-run --treat-preview-as-live --annotate=exp_replay_may18` -> Result: 31 ids processed -> 28 would apply credits, 3 flagged duplicate/skipped. Dry-run CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/replay/dryruns/exp_replay_may18.csv

billing-bot: [auto] replay-job queued job_id=exp_replay_629 queued_by=nina eta=2026-05-18T03:30:00Z

harper: Finance review: please attach CSV and highlight any >$1 adjustments. We'll approve once verified. Accounting policy: closed invoices should get credit memos rather than reopening.

accounting: Uploaded note: approve applies for amounts <= $50 automatically; for >$50 we need manual sign-off. See comment in CSV.

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job started job_id=exp_replay_629 status=dry_run_started

nina: Real run executed after approvals. Command: `python tools/replay_webhooks.py --ids-file preview_ids.txt --treat-preview-as-live --annotate=exp_replay_may18 --idempotency=event_id+invoice`

billing-bot: [auto] replay-job completed job_id=exp_replay_629 applied=28 skipped_duplicates=3 memos_created=4 failures=0 duration=00:08:22

harper: NetSuite apply IDs attached: s3://redwood-prod/replay/exp_replay_may18/applies.csv. Finance performed reconcile; totals match Stripe. Accounting will handle the 4 memos for closed invoices.

leo: Postmortem actions: (1) fix proxy to prevent forwarding X-Billing-Experiment for prod traffic, (2) require experiment headers to be validated by source (don't trust client-supplied header), (3) add an alert when preview_experiment flag >0.1% of events in prod, (4) add replay runbook page for pricing experiments. I'll open PRs.

accounting: Also request: add an annotation column in replay artifacts for experiment_id so audit trails can tie charge -> experiment.

nina: Done. Replayed artifacts now include experiment_id and original_preview_flag.

ops-bot: [auto] incident-notification sent to #product #security #finance at 2026-05-18T04:05:00Z

harper: Thanks team. Finance closed the reconciliation. We'll send customer communication only for any invoice that materially changed after memos applied. Closing thread once postmortem doc is linked. :white_check_mark:
